issues.title: Receive SMS Notifications at company-issued mobile device number
issues.description:
As a ORBIT user who has a Government Issued mobile device and who has entered the number for the Government issued mobile device on my ORBIT profile, I want to receive SMS notifications at that number whenever I meet the criteria for an SMS notification that is sent by my organization.

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- If a user has entered a valid phone number in the "Government Issued Mobile Device" field of their profile, when a Notification Manager sends an SMS notification with conditions that the user meets, the user receives an SMS notification at the number entered in the "Government Issued Mobile Device" field.
- If a user has entered a separate number in the Notification Information section of their profile, they also receive the notification at that number.

issues.title: "Send Notification" button disabled until "SEND" entered
issues.description:
As a Notification Manager who is preparing to send a notification from the Notification Confirmation page, I want the "Send Notification" button to be disabled unless I have entered "SEND" into the appropriate field so that I don't accidentally click the button without confirming the contents and audience of the notification.

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- When the Notification Confirmation page loads for a Notification Manager, the "Send Notification" button will be disabled
- When the Notification Manager enters anything other than "SEND" (capitalization matters), the button will remain disabled
- When the Notification Manager clicks on the button after entering anything other than "SEND" (capitalization matters), nothing will happen
- When the Notification Manager enters "SEND", the button will become active
- When the Notification Manager clicks the "Send Notification" button after entering "SEND", the notification will be sent

issues.title: Explanatory text for "Send toNotification Managers" field
issues.description:
As a Notification Manager creating a notification, I want to see help text for the "Send to Notification Managers" field so I can understand the app's behavior associated with my selection.

---

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- When a user views the notification page and the "Send to Notification Managers" field has a value of "No", the following message will be displayed immediately below the field.
> This notification will be sent only to employee who match the criteria in the "To" field above
- When a user views the notification page and the "Send to Notification Managers" field has a value of "Yes", the following message will be displayed immediately below the field.
> This notification will be sent to employee who match the criteria in the "To" field above and to all Notification Managers in your organization

issues.title: [BUG] "Emergency Contact 2" Overwriting "Emergency Contact 1"
issues.description:
If a user enters information only in "Emergency Contact 1", the information is saved correctly. 

If the user then also enters information for "Emergency Contact 2", the Name and Phone number information is overwriting "Emergency Contact 1" information Name and Phone number. The relationship field in Emergency Contact 1 is not affected.

If the user enters no information for Emergency Contact 1 and enters information for Emergency Contact 2, the Name and Phone number information for Emergency Contact 2 is also entered "Emergency Contact 1" information. The relationship field in Emergency Contact 1 is not affected.

issues.title: [BUG] Future check-in not active after employee transfer
issues.description:
When a user is transferred from one org / layer to another, their Future Check-In information is still in their record but is not "seen" by the DNR reporting. So even though they have a valid future check-in, they show up on the DNR list. 

Report from user:
> (PL C2 Enablers) ORBIT is showing employees as not reported event though they reported. This started after the change over to the new Organization Layers. I found that if I open the future check-ins for an individual and save it will take them off the list. It looks like the future check-ins did not transfer over. I could open each persons futures check-ins and save to clear them but that is a lot of people. I talked to other commands and they have the same problem. This PO wide problem.

issues.title: [BUG] Changing Layer assignment for Notification Managers
issues.description:
WHAT'S HAPPENING:

When an Org Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role for a specific layer (layer x), and then creates a new Notification Manager role for a different layer (layer y), the layers available for the Notification Manager when creating a notification include both layer x and layer y.

When an Org Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role for a specific layer (layer x), and then creates a new Notification Manager role at the Organization level (leaving the layer selection field blank), only the original layer (layer x) is available for the Notification Manager when creating a notification.

WHAT SHOULD HAPPEN:

When an Org Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role for a specific layer (layer x), and then creates a new Notification Manager role for a different layer (layer y), the layers available for the Notification Manager when creating a notification should include only layer y.

When an Org Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role for a specific layer (layer x), and then creates a new Notification Manager role at the Organization level (leaving the layer selection field blank), all layers should be available for the Notification Manager when creating a notification.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- When an Organization Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role at a specific layer (layer x) and creates a new Notification Manager role for the same user at a different layer (layer y), AND the user selects "Organization Layer" when creating a new notification, THEN only layer y is available for the user to select.
- When an Organization Manager inactivates a Notification Manager role at a specific layer (layer x) and creates a new Notification Manager role for the same user at the organization level, AND the user selects "Organization Layer" when creating a new notification, THEN all active layers in the organization are available for the user to select.
